HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.
   C. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

4. Which response best shows understanding of Kalpasutra and Dhammapada? (1 mark)
   A. Use Kalpasutra and Dhammapada to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Kalpasutra and Dhammapada has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Kalpasutra and Dhammapada.
   D. Apply the teaching of Kalpasutra and Dhammapada with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Myself? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Myself with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself.
   C. Say Myself has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Myself to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Specific morning? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Specific morning with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Specific morning to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Specific morning has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Specific morning.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Religious? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Religious.
   B. Use Religious to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Religious has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Religious with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

9. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   C. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Qualities of? (1 mark)
   A. Use Qualities of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Qualities of has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Qualities of.
   D. Apply the teaching of Qualities of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Myself and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Specific morning and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Qualities of and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Kalpasutra and Dhammapada and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Pranayam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain General Etiquette and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
